desc: Build a Trie from all words, storing at each node the count of words passing through it.
For each depth, compute the top two counts (`m1`, `m2`) and the count of nodes achieving `m1` (`cnt1`).
For each word, traverse the Trie to determine the longest prefix length where the adjusted count (accounting for the removal of the current word) is at least `k`.
Return the array of answers for each removal.
